## Why

Raw OCFL captures keep what ingest discards (J4 NEW-4): F-406 found three
byte classes — OSM `user`/`uid` from `out meta`, Eyes-on-Flock
`summary.top_search_reasons` free text, all-attribute ArcGIS captures —
that may sit at rest in the evidence store, plus the I7 S1–S9 screen
classes on captured lane members and the SIG-PUB-002 never-publish
categories. Until this row nothing could answer *"does the store hold
Part VIII-protected bytes?"* without reading the bytes. Now a
deterministic counts-only screen answers it, and an append-only
protective-seal register + two-carrier deny set removes every flagged
capture from every publishable path — suppression, never deletion
(SIG-GOV-007, ADR-185, ADR-203). True purge stays the operator's WV-11
action (ADR-181/189), never this row.

## What ships

- **`evidence/src/evidence/screen.py`** — the pure Part VIII byte screen:
  field-name/pattern rules for the three F-406 classes, the nine I7
  lane classes (member-glob scoped, per-lane vocabularies), and the five
  SIG-PUB-002 categories. `screen_blob` returns `{class_id: hit_count}`
  — a field name or value is an input, never an output. Rule
  configuration travels in the committed
  `sig.at-rest-audit-decl/1` (`ops/at_rest_audit.toml`) so the applied
  screen is auditable byte-for-byte; the declaration validates fail-closed.
- **`ops/src/ops/at_rest_audit.py` + `sig-ops at-rest
  scan|seal-plan|seal-apply|seal-verify`** — the scanner walks OCFL
  inventory objects (local root or `gs://` prefix), resolves each
  capture's current bytes + `metadata.json`, joins optional spine rows by
  content digest, and emits the counts-only **`sig.at-rest-audit/1`**
  report (objects scanned, per-class × per-source hit counts, PUB-002
  category counts — never a field name, value or excerpt) plus the
  restricted **`sig.at-rest-flagged/1`** sidecar (object/digest ids +
  class ids + joined capture ids — explicitly marked restricted, never
  for the public repo). `seal-plan` builds
  **`sig.at-rest-seal-plan/1`** + the **`sig.seal-deny/1`** deny-set body
  + the counts-only **`sig.pub002-listing/1`** for the operator's later
  purge decision. `seal-apply` is dry-run by default, refuses
  (`not_evaluable`/exit 42) while `capture_seal` is undeployed, skips
  already-sealed captures on the latest-action consult, and writes
  append-only `capture_seal` rows + `withhold` publication dispositions —
  insert-only, never an UPDATE/DELETE.
- **`db/` `seal_register` sqitch change** (deploy/revert/verify + plan
  entry after `audit_login`; L44–52 byte-identical, C-10) —
  **`capture_seal`**: one append-only row per seal/unseal action (FK
  `evidence_capture`, `rules[]` class ids, author, audit-report ref,
  DB-clock `recorded_at`, immutability trigger, no UPDATE/DELETE grant
  anywhere), the **`capture_currently_sealed(uuid)`** latest-action
  helper both consults inline, the NEW NOLOGIN **`sig_seal_writer`**
  (INSERT-only — the L2 leg's auditable write surface), column-limited
  SELECT for `sig_read_public`/`sig_export` (id/action/rules — never the
  flagged material), and a `spine_watermark` facet.
- **Serving consult** (`api/src/api/store_pg.py`) — `PgReadStore.capture`
  consults `capture_seal`: a capture whose latest action is `seal` serves
  the SIG-EVID-010 sealed representation (existence, source, date,
  digest, claims — nothing else) on every publishable path whatever its
  stored tier; `seal_rules` rides the metadata object for the authorized
  surface only — `public_representation` never serializes it. A
  pre-`seal_register` spine answers "not sealed" honestly.
- **Export consult** (`exports/src/exports/spine_export.py`) —
  evidence bindings gain the `{CAPTURE_SEAL_GATE}` fragment
  (`NOT capture_currently_sealed(ce.capture_id)`, honest-absent on a
  pre-seal spine) so a sealed capture loses its public bindings exactly
  as a withheld artifact does; a defensive post-check re-verifies no
  emitted binding names a currently-sealed capture (fail-closed), and
  `sealed_bindings_dropped`/`sealed_bindings_suppressed` record
  counts only.
- **`evidence/src/evidence/seal.py`** — the `sig.seal-deny/1`
  document: build/validate/load, `denied_ids`/`denied_digests`, the
  superseding-version semantics (a new object version replaces the set,
  never an in-place rewrite), fail-closed validation.
- **`ops/gcp/at-rest-audit.sh`** — the windowed two-leg script
  (`prestate → backup → scan → seal → verify`, plus `rollback`, `all`):
  check-mode default prints every command (no ADC, no network); apply
  exits **42** inside the freeze / the 03:00–06:30Z band / while the
  P34.43 exec identity is absent (L1) or while no `sig.at-rest-audit/1`
  report, AR-2 backup or `capture_seal` deploy exists (L2); prestate
  records per-tier counts, the publishable-path list, and a
  name+generation listing of every capture/seal object (the "no byte
  deleted or overwritten" baseline); verify asserts zero object
  deletions/generation replacements pre→post and a sealed-digest serving
  read-back; rollback is superseding records only (an `unseal` row + a
  deny-set version restoring prior entries — deliberately not
  window-gated, never a delete).
- **`evidence/tiers.py` `seal_rules` field + `ops/gcp/config.sh`
  `SIG_ATREST_*` exports + `ops/at_rest_audit.toml`** — the declared
  screen classes, member globs, and vocabularies (auditable,
  fail-closed).
- **ADR-203** — the protective-seal two-carrier deny set (DB
  `capture_seal` + restricted-bucket `sig.seal-deny/1` versions),
  counts-only reporting, the no-deletion/overwrite and operator-only
  purge invariants, restricted/public separation, the P37.3 copy-path
  deferral; ADR index + Appendix F row + trigger register + BL-084
  mapping.
- **Owed rows routed** — `D-P34.49-1` (P37.3's off-instance copies must
  exclude currently-sealed captures or separately encrypt them; owner:
  P37.3) and `D-P34.49-2` (the capture-writer `user`/`uid` fix behind
  F-406's OSM half — `extract()` strips after the raw capture lands;
  owner: the connectors capture path, orchestrator routes, candidate home
  P35.31; trigger: the next OSM replay fire) — DEFERRALS rows +
  obligation-event `e0` anchors.
- Tests: `tests/evidence/test_screen.py` (23), `test_seal.py` (6),
  `tests/ops/test_at_rest_audit.py` (12), `tests/db/test_capture_seal.py`
  (8, Docker), `tests/ops/test_gcp_iac.py` (+`at-rest-audit.sh` to both
  sweeps).

## Boundaries

**No production mutation ran or runs in this row.** Both legs queue with
exit 42; the `seal_register` sqitch change is committed but not deployed
to hosted — the hosted plan advance is P34.46's. Sealing is suppression
only: append-only `capture_seal` rows + `withhold` dispositions + a new
deny-set object version — **no byte is deleted, moved by delete, or
overwritten**. A true purge stays the operator's WV-11 action
(ADR-181/189), never this row. The counts-only report and PUB-002 listing
carry no field names, values or excerpts; flagged ids live only in the
restricted bucket. No `ingestion_permitted` flip, no `HG-nn` gate ticked.
